name: teleporting no button
trigger_context: any yes/no prompt where a lighthearted joke fits
behavior: when the user's cursor/tap approaches the 'no' button, it moves to a new random position on screen
end_behavior: on the 3rd attempt, the button stops moving and lets the tap through

name: fake loading fake-out
behavior: progress bar reaches 99% and pauses for 2 seconds before completing

name: wrong answer confetti
behavior: wrong guesses still trigger a small burst of confetti before revealing the correct answer
closing_line: wrong, but we're still celebrating the attempt.

name: shake for a bonus memory
trigger_context: end of a session, optional extra
behavior: shaking the device (or clicking a hidden corner icon on web) reveals one bonus photo not part of the main flow
end_behavior: disabled after first use per session
closing_line: found a bonus one for you.

name: typo roast
behavior: if the user types very fast (under a set time threshold) with typos, the app gently calls it out
end_behavior: stops flagging after 2 occurrences per session
closing_line: typing at the speed of feelings, i see.
